answer: A bond is refunded only after 48 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The hollow counter is kept in juniper and raven exposes each reset. An hostile operator hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 48 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 162 aliases cost 309 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
